bug_reason: Repeatedly creates new quantum registers whose qubits do not belong to the circuit.
fix_reason: Register ownership and real Aer sampling pass in all 23 versions. A separate semantic check fails: the oracle applies CZ only to the first two qubits, so it flips two basis-state phases instead of only the requested three-qubit state. The original register-error repair works, but the residual Grover oracle error prevents an overall pass.

The operator-interface repair works, but the separate mixer-semantics check fails.
